newsitem.title: USA: United Space gets NASA $7 bln contract.
newsitem.headline: United Space gets NASA $7 bln contract.

text.p: United Space Alliance said Monday it has been awarded a contract by the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration designating it as the single prime contractor for Space Shuttle operations as of October 1.
The contract, which will have a base period of six years with two, two-year options, is expected to be worth about $7 billion in the initial phase, it said.

United Space Alliance is a joint venture of Rockwell International Corp and Lockheed Martin Corp. As part of Boeing Co's acquisition of Rockwell's aerospace and defense business, Rockwell's share of United Space Alliance will be transferred to Boeing North American Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Boeing Co, pending approvals expected in late 1996, United Space Alliance said.
As part of the contract, United Space Alliance will be responsible for the orbiter, flight and ground operations, and logistics support.
